comment: Upstream watermarks for the update-patterns skill. Each entry records the last upstream commit whose behaviour was reconciled with this catalog. Update last_checked_commit only after the affected concepts were re-read and corrected (or confirmed still correct).

sources.notes: Reconciled through keiki 0.9.0.0 (release commit 9714d37, tagged v0.9.0.0 at master head). 0.9 was read from src/Keiki/{Core,Generics,Generics/TH,Composition,Profunctor,Symbolic}.hs and the new src/Keiki/Internal/WireSchema.hs, not from the changelog alone: sealed InCtor/WireCtor pattern synonyms over private MkInCtor/MkWireCtor, the trusted*Internal capability behind Keiki.Internal.ConstructorEvidence, the mk*Via/mk*RecordVia/mkWireCtor0Via producers, unavailable*/rename*, the four deprecations, classifyWireHeads/classifyInputHeads/classifyInputWireHeads, wireHeadsMayAliasForDefault's trusted-vs-wcName fallback, the two-stage inversionAmbiguityWarnings with its exact-integral conjunct proof, checkInversionAmbiguitySym(Detailed) failing closed on non-unique details, ComposeAlignmentWarning's StructurallyDifferentInputWire/UnwitnessedInputWireAlignment, the UnwitnessedInputConstructorIdentity TranslationIssue, and Profunctor maps building through the unavailable* path. keiki-codec-json 0.9 is bounds-only with an unchanged wire format. Added keiki/constructor-evidence as the cross-cutting standard the three consumers link to. Earlier cycles: 0.7 Keiki.ProjectionDomain, ExactFieldProjection/exactFieldWitness and the checkFieldProjection* laws, the conservative reclassification of one-way fieldWitness projections, verifyPredicateDetailed/predicateTranslationReport, and the detailed step and replay attribution APIs; 0.8 Show on lit plus opaqueLit/TOpaqueLit, and readable-by-default Mermaid with MermaidUpdateMode/toTopologyMermaid. Watch paths corrected earlier: the library is src/, not the keiki-core and keiki-diagrams directories a previous entry named.

Reconciled through keiro 0.8.0.0 (release commit 80cd515), deliberately NOT master head. 0.7: language version 3 on the frozen keiro-dsl/id-domain/typeid-v7/1 contract (new keiro-core Keiro.Codec.IdDomain), one Generated.<Context>.Nominals owner with abstract v3 IDs, the CheckedService/EffectiveLanguageContract boundary, behavior obligations and the keiro/behavior-conformance/1 report, generated fields(Command) identity, AggregateEventlessStateChange, and keiki >=0.7 with its widened UnverifiedOpaque surface. 0.8: explicit syntax-profile and runtime-semantics selection per registry entry, LanguageDefinition (..), and the located Keiro.Dsl.Source/Syntax/Frontend API. Master carries unreleased 0.9-bound work (language 4, FNV-1a-128 fold fingerprints, Either FoldSurfaceError service APIs, removal of the Spec-only wrappers) that is excluded until it releases.
